tier_definitions.msm_d2_12z: D-2 12 UTC run, FH27-50, one run per whole day; disseminated D-2 23:30 JST (+10h30m pre-gate)
tier_definitions.msm_gate_composite: per-slot freshest admissible run: D-2 21 UTC for hours 00-21 (+90 min pre-gate), D-2 12 UTC for hours 22-23
tier_definitions.msm_d1_00z: D-1 00 UTC run, FH15-38, one run per whole day; disseminated D-1 11:30 JST (1h30m POST-gate)

gate5_reproducibility.consequence_if_fail: Abort. Unaccounted non-determinism in the harness would make the new run-pinned numbers untrustworthy as well.

gate6_pregate_value.headline_rule: the smaller of the two run-pinned pre-gate tiers, fixed before results (conservative)

tick.rationale: one JEPX price tick, verified as the exact 0.01 JPY/kWh grid of all realised prices in the panel. A smallness benchmark grounded in the market's own price granularity, NOT an operational no-impact threshold: the tested quantity is the pooled mean absolute error, and mean-level equivalence does not bound individual slot forecast differences or imply that no bid would change. The decision-scale consequence is tested separately (phase75)

relevance.rationale: 20% of the pre-gate improvement; a practical-relevance margin, reported as SECONDARY because it is anchored on an estimate rather than on the market's price granularity

equivalence.smallest_margin_note: smallest symmetric margin whose interval contains the 90% CI; a DESCRIPTIVE by-product, NOT a pre-committed margin

gate7_gate_timing.reading: 7b: the value of the run the gate excludes is not distinguishable from zero; reported as an upper bound

per_area_gate_timing.definition: MAE(msm_d2_12z) - MAE(msm_d1_00z) per area; positive means the post-gate run is more accurate
